PAGMO2 2.19.1 BOUNDED NUMERIC SESSION ADAPTER

The pinned source archive and its upstream SHA256 remain unchanged.
tools/patch-pagmo-state.ps1 and tools/patch_pagmo_state.py idempotently add one
forward declaration and one friend declaration to each of five algorithm headers:
sade,cmaes,sga,nsga2,cstrs_self_adaptive. Algorithm implementations, data-member
layouts, public methods and mathematical update formulas are unchanged.

Studio's StateAccess adapter stores only numeric adaptation vectors/matrices,
counters and fixed-size textual RNG state. It validates JSON lengths and matrix
dimensions against checked request dimensions/populations BEFORE allocation.
No Boost archive, type-erasure object, problem, BFE, resident callback pointer,
source executable authority or arbitrary DLL path is restored from a checkpoint.
Fresh checked callbacks/problem/BFE/configuration are attached by the owner.

The library is rebuilt from the same patched headers for a consistent C++ ODR.
The original GPL3/LGPL3 notices and full pinned sources remain available under
third-party; this patch changes access declarations only. Both Windows and Linux
explicit dependency bootstraps apply it before compiling/installing the SDK.
